description: Generate timed on-screen caption cues for a video on your own product — a transcript plus start/end-timed lines. Does not burn captions onto any video or touch stored media; only returns the cue data. If no AI provider is configured the result carries provider: "mock" placeholder captions rather than an error — check that field before treating the captions as real. Billed like the dashboard's own Generate Captions button: your workspace's plan AI credits, not your personal MCP credits. Use when the user needs timed on-screen captions for one of their videos.

appId.description: Your product's id. Omit only with a single-app workspace.

transcriptHint.description: Known dialogue/voiceover, if any, to ground the cues.

name: generate_captions

provider.description: "mock" when no AI provider is configured — the cues are placeholders.

transcript.description: The transcript the cues were cut from.

title: Generate Captions
